reason: I'd use the free visit, and if it's nice I'd bring my moms group for a Group Morning at $8 a kid, since that's the only price that works for us. I'm not paying $14 a visit or $45 a month on one household's shift-work budget.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? $14 a kid adds up fast when I've got more than one, and I can't tell why it's worth that much more.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in price closer to $8-10 for a first kid, or proof on the free visit that it's calmer and cleaner than CoCo's.
